tool_selection.reasoning: These tools are selected because they provide complementary, robust, and widely validated attribution methods for tabular data. SHAP offers global and local interpretability grounded in game theory, LIME provides local approximations with interpretable models, Integrated Gradients offer smooth gradient-based attribution from baseline, and sensitivity analysis directly measures feature impact through ablation. Together, they provide a comprehensive and cross-validated view of feature responsibility.
